Hi Sanjay / Erin —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + the proposed MAP I promised to share. Please confirm owners/dates below and flag anything I missed.

Key stakeholders we captured on the call:
- Economic buyer: Sanjay Patel (CFO) — financial/commitment decision
- Technical buyer: Erin O'Connell (Head of Platform) — performance/security requirements
- Security reviewer: Lena Wu (InfoSec) — questionnaire + data flow review
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (e.g., Monica Rao) — PO/contract steps

Primary decision criteria we logged:
- Latency: 95th percentile < 150ms for production traffic
- Unit economics: target <$0.02/token for committed volume
- Data residency/retention controls & SOC2 coverage
- Integration: SSO + secure key management

Proposed MAP (high level) — please confirm owners/dates: 
1) Security review kickoff with Redwood SE (Priyom) — by 2026-06-18
2) Procurement/contract template review (FinPay procurement) — complete by 2026-06-25
3) POC (3 weeks) — start 2026-07-01, run through 2026-07-21
4) Exec sponsor signoff (final approval) — target 2026-07-22

Attached: FinPay-MAP-v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones), FinPay-stakeholder-map.pdf (stakeholder map)

Next actions for you: please: 1) confirm that owners above are correct (especially procurement contact), 2) confirm procurement timeline (how long after legal review do you typically route to procurement?), and 3) let us know any additional non-negotiable requirements for the POC (data handling, retention).

Happy to jump on a quick sync if easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
